Core definitions of the composed CLI game: wire parsers, driver, KeyInd handler, cost budgets

Trusted: definitions used by the statement. Every declaration in this file lies in the closure of Computational/Theorems/Main.lean (via Computational/Specifications/Game/StatementPq.lean, Computational/Specifications/LibsignalCli/StatementPqElf.lean, and Computational/Specifications/Reductions/Pqxdh/StatementPqReds.lean). See Computational/docs/DEVIATIONS.md.

Non-ELF building blocks of the composed PQXDH + Double Ratchet security game played against the libsignal CLI binary (StatementPq.lean). The bh / BH ("binary harness") prefix denotes the game in which sessions carry wire-byte state (BinState) rather than abstract model state (GhostState Bytes). The adversary interacts with four oracle families: uniform coins, the PQXDH key-indistinguishability game KeyInd, the session-promotion control oracle startDR sid, and per-instance ACD19 secure-messaging (SM) oracles; the driver mirrors the public KeyInd transcript, guards promotion, and runs each promoted instance as an SM game.

This file also connects the composed game specifications (bhGameSpec, bhTargetGameSpec) to the ReductionDsl operation tables and codecs of AtomicOps.lean and TargetCodecs.lean, and defines the closed-form step-cost budgets bhAdapterCostBudget (for the wire-to-model adapter) and bhE2ECostBudget (for the multi-session composition reductions in StatementPqReds.lean), along with their online/offline per-kind counterparts bhAdapterCostBudgetByKind and bhE2ECostBudgetByKind.

def bhReadProstVarintL59–64 ↗#

Decode one LEB128 varint, returning (value, remainingBytes).

def bhReadProstVarint : List (BitVec 8) → Option (ℕ × List (BitVec 8)) | [] => none | b :: rest => if b.toNat < 128 then some (b.toNat, rest) else (bhReadProstVarint rest).map (fun (hi, rest') => (b.toNat - 128 + 128 * hi, rest'))

def bhParseOptPreKeyIdL66–71 ↗#

Parse optional protobuf field 1 (preKeyId, tag 0x08#8).

def bhParseOptPreKeyId : List (BitVec 8) → Option (Option UInt32 × List (BitVec 8)) | [] => some (none, []) | b :: rest => if b == 0x08#8 then (bhReadProstVarint rest).map (fun (n, r) => (some (UInt32.ofNat n), r)) else some (none, b :: rest)

structure ModelDriverInstanceMetaL322–340 ↗#

Per-instance freshness and responder-slot metadata.

DEV-C17 (formalization): initiator-identity freshness at Bob's first accept, and no adversary revealSpkSk. In KeyInd, initiator freshness (isKeyIndInitStillFresh) inspects only the responder's keys, whereas Bob's handshake binds ikA only via DH(spkB_sk, ikA). Corrupting ikA or revealing spkB_sk before Bob's first accept would let an adversary forge a pre-key message under ikA while Alice's session remains KeyInd-fresh (DEV-PQ24). Each promoted instance records whether Bob has accepted (bobAccepted), whether ikA was corrupted at that first accept (ikACorrAtAccept), and its responder slot (respPrin, respSpkIdx), while revealedSpks logs adversarial revealSpkSk queries (excluding the driver's own reveal at startDR, DEV-C10). Once bhDrvInstClean (or bhE2EDrvInstClean) fails for instance i, SM queries on i return none without affecting other instances. Effect: restricts the adversary.

structure ModelDriverInstanceMeta (S : SignalPqxdh.Setup) where bobAccepted : Bool := false ikACorrAtAccept : Bool := false respPrin : Option (Fin S.N_id) := none respSpkIdx : Option (Fin S.N_recv) := none instOpkId? : Option UInt32 := none deriving DecidableEq, Repr

def bhDrvAcceptIkOkL373–386 ↗#

Byte-exact ikA pin on responder accepts.

DEV-C15 (formalization): byte-exact identity pins on KeyInd handshake queries, and no revealDhSecrets. KeyInd matches identity keys modulo the cofactor projection P.pow8, so an 8-torsion twin ikA + T of a mirrored honest principal's key passes acceptOPK / acceptNoOPK and consumes the responder's pre-key slot and Kyber replay tuple. The driver forwards a responder accept only if hdr.ikAPk is byte-equal to a mirrored principal key (bhDrvAcceptIkOk), and an initiateOPK / initiateNoOPK only if no mirrored principal key is a distinct pow8-twin of bnd.ikB (bhDrvInitiateIkOk); the signed pre-key is checked byte-for-byte at startDR (DEV-C9). bhDrvKiQueryOk also refuses revealDhSecrets (DEV-PQ19, DEV-PQ23) and testSession (DEV-C12). Effect: restricts the adversary.

def bhDrvAcceptIkOk {S : SignalPqxdh.Setup} (ds : ModelDriverBase S) (hdr : SignalPqxdh.HandshakeHdr) : Bool := ds.prins.any (fun e => e.2 == hdr.ikAPk)

def bhDrvInitiateIkOkL388–392 ↗#

Reject bundles whose ikB is a distinct pow8-twin of a mirrored honest principal key (DEV-C19).

def bhDrvInitiateIkOk {S : SignalPqxdh.Setup} (P : SignalPqxdh.Primitives) (ds : ModelDriverBase S) (bnd : SignalPqxdh.PreKeyBundleInput) : Bool := !ds.prins.any (fun (_, pk) => P.pow8 pk == P.pow8 bnd.ikB && pk != bnd.ikB)

def bhDrvKiQueryOkL394–401 ↗#

Admissibility filter on KeyIndQuery in the composed game (DEV-C12, DEV-C15, DEV-C19).

def bhDrvKiQueryOk {S : SignalPqxdh.Setup} (P : SignalPqxdh.Primitives) (ds : ModelDriverBase S) : SignalPqxdh.KeyIndQuery S → Bool | .testSession _ | .revealDhSecrets => false | .initiateOPK _ _ bnd => bnd.opkB?.isSome && bhDrvInitiateIkOk P ds bnd | .initiateNoOPK _ _ bnd => bnd.opkB?.isNone && bhDrvInitiateIkOk P ds bnd | .acceptOPK _ _ _ hdr | .acceptNoOPK _ _ _ hdr => bhDrvAcceptIkOk ds hdr | _ => true

def bhNoOpkRespPromotedL403–410 ↗#

Whether u is the responder of a promoted no-OPK instance (respPrin = some u and instOpkId? = none). Because startDR reveals the responder's signed pre-key (DEV-C10), a subsequent corruptIK u on a no-OPK session would violate isKeyIndInitStillFresh and void the entire run via allTestedSessionsFresh; the composed drivers therefore refuse corruptIK u once this holds, complementing the !corrPrins.contains u check in bhDrvGuard.

def bhNoOpkRespPromoted {S : SignalPqxdh.Setup} (instMeta : List (ModelDriverInstanceMeta S)) (u : Fin S.N_id) : Bool := instMeta.any (fun im => im.respPrin == some u && im.instOpkId?.isNone)

def bhDrvInstCleanL419–427 ↗#

Per-instance cleanliness check on ModelDriverState (DEV-C17): requires an initiator principal, uncorrupted ikA at Bob's first accept, and no adversarial revealSpkSk on bi.respSlot.

def bhDrvInstClean {S : SignalPqxdh.Setup} {ℓ : ℕ} (ds : ModelDriverState S ℓ) (i : ℕ) : Bool := match ds.bhInsts[i]?, ds.instMeta[i]? with | some bi, some im => (bhDrvSessionInitPrin? bi.sid).isSome && !im.ikACorrAtAccept && !ds.revealedSpks.contains bi.respSlot | _, _ => true

def allTestedSessionsFreshL429–438 ↗#

End-of-game freshness predicate requiring every tested initiator and responder session in st to remain fresh (DEV-C10).

def allTestedSessionsFresh {S : SignalPqxdh.Setup} (P : SignalPqxdh.Primitives) (st : SignalPqxdh.KeyIndState S) : Bool := st.sessions.all (fun s => !s.tested || SignalPqxdh.isKeyIndInitStillFresh P true st.principals st.spkBundles st.respSessions s) && st.respSessions.all (fun r => !r.tested || SignalPqxdh.isKeyIndRespStillFresh P true st.principals st.spkBundles st.sessions r)

def bhBaseMirrorL444–458 ↗#

Record public keys, bundles, OPKs, and initiator headers from a KeyInd step in ModelDriverBase.

def bhBaseMirror {S : SignalPqxdh.Setup} (ds : ModelDriverBase S) (q : SignalPqxdh.KeyIndQuery S) (r : SignalPqxdh.KeyIndResponse) : ModelDriverBase S := match q, r with | .initPrin u, .initPrinResp ikPk _ => { ds with prins := (u, ikPk) :: ds.prins } | .genSPK u j, .bundleResp bnd => { ds with bundles := ((u, j), (bnd.spkB, bnd.pqspkB)) :: ds.bundles } | .genOPK u j o, .pkResp opkPk => { ds with opks := ((u, j, o), opkPk) :: ds.opks } | .initiateOPK u i bnd, .hdrResp hdr => { ds with sends := (.sendOPK u i, bnd, hdr) :: ds.sends } | .initiateNoOPK u i bnd, .hdrResp hdr => { ds with sends := (.sendNoOPK u i, bnd, hdr) :: ds.sends } | _, _ => ds

def bhDrvMirrorL460–470 ↗#

Extend bhBaseMirror on ModelDriverState with corrupted principals and adversarially revealed SPK slots.

def bhDrvMirror {S : SignalPqxdh.Setup} {ℓ : ℕ} (ds : ModelDriverState S ℓ) (q : SignalPqxdh.KeyIndQuery S) (r : SignalPqxdh.KeyIndResponse) : ModelDriverState S ℓ := let dsBase := bhBaseMirror ds.toModelDriverBase q r let corrPrins' := match q, r with | .corruptIK u, .corrResp _ _ => u :: ds.corrPrins | _, _ => ds.corrPrins let revSpks' := match q, r with | .revealSpkSk u j, .spkSkResp _ => (u, j) :: ds.revealedSpks | _, _ => ds.revealedSpks { ds with toModelDriverBase := dsBase, corrPrins := corrPrins', revealedSpks := revSpks' }

def bhBaseOpkOkL472–481 ↗#

Whether bnd.opkB? matches a mirrored OPK of responder slot (u, j) (DEV-C20).

def bhBaseOpkOk {S : SignalPqxdh.Setup} (ds : ModelDriverBase S) (u : Fin S.N_id) (j : Fin S.N_recv) (bnd : SignalPqxdh.PreKeyBundleInput) : Bool := match bnd.opkB? with | none => true | some (opkId, opkPk) => ds.opks.any (fun ((u', j', o), pk) => u' == u && j' == j && UInt32.ofNat o.val == opkId && o.val == opkId.toNat && pk == opkPk)

def bhDrvGuardL483–507 ↗#

Session-promotion guard for startDR sid (DEV-C9, DEV-C10, DEV-C20): checks uniqueness of sid and ekAPk, matches the bundle and optional OPK against mirrored honest keys of some slot (u, j), and for no-OPK handshakes requires !ds.corrPrins.contains u.

def bhDrvGuard {S : SignalPqxdh.Setup} {ℓ : ℕ} (ds : ModelDriverState S ℓ) (sid : SignalPqxdh.SessionId S) : Option (SignalPqxdh.HandshakeHdr × SignalPqxdh.PreKeyBundleInput × (Fin S.N_id × Fin S.N_recv)) := if ds.bhInsts.any (fun bi => bi.sid == sid) then none else match ds.sends.find? (fun (s, _, _) => s == sid) with | none => none | some (_, bnd, hdr) => if ds.bhInsts.any (fun bi => bi.hdr.ekAPk == hdr.ekAPk) then none else match ds.bundles.find? (fun ((_, j), (spkB, pqspkB)) => spkB == bnd.spkB && pqspkB == bnd.pqspkB && hdr.spkId == UInt32.ofNat j.val && hdr.pqspkId == UInt32.ofNat j.val) with | none => none | some ((u, j), _) => if ds.prins.any (fun (u', pk) => u' == u && pk == bnd.ikB) && bhBaseOpkOk ds.toModelDriverBase u j bnd && (bnd.opkB?.isSome || !ds.corrPrins.contains u) then some (hdr, bnd, (u, j)) else none

def bhE2EMirror {S : SignalPqxdh.Setup} {ℓ : ℕ} (σ : BHE2EDrvState S ℓ) (q : SignalPqxdh.KeyIndQuery S) (r : SignalPqxdh.KeyIndResponse) : BHE2EDrvState S ℓ := let base' := bhBaseMirror σ.toModelDriverBase q r let corr' := match q, r with | .corruptIK u, .corrResp _ _ => u :: σ.corrPrins | _, _ => σ.corrPrins let revSpks' := match q, r with | .revealSpkSk u j, .spkSkResp _ => (u, j) :: σ.revealedSpks | _, _ => σ.revealedSpks { σ with toModelDriverBase := base', corrPrins := corr', revealedSpks := revSpks' }

def bhE2EGuard {S : SignalPqxdh.Setup} {ℓ : ℕ} (σ : BHE2EDrvState S ℓ) (sid : SignalPqxdh.SessionId S) : Option (SignalPqxdh.HandshakeHdr × SignalPqxdh.PreKeyBundleInput × (Fin S.N_id × Fin S.N_recv)) := if σ.insts.any (fun d => d.sid == sid) then none else match σ.sends.find? (fun (s, _, _) => s == sid) with | none => none | some (_, bnd, hdr) => if σ.insts.any (fun d => d.hdr.ekAPk == hdr.ekAPk) then none else match σ.bundles.find? (fun ((_, j), (spkB, pqspkB)) => spkB == bnd.spkB && pqspkB == bnd.pqspkB && hdr.spkId == UInt32.ofNat j.val && hdr.pqspkId == UInt32.ofNat j.val) with | none => none | some ((u, j), _) => if σ.prins.any (fun (u', pk) => u' == u && pk == bnd.ikB) && bhBaseOpkOk σ.toModelDriverBase u j bnd && (bnd.opkB?.isSome || !σ.corrPrins.contains u) then some (hdr, bnd, (u, j)) else none

def bhE2EFinishStartSpkL995–1017 ↗#

Complete startDR sid on BHE2EDrvState from KeyInd responses (kr1, kr2) and Alice's ratchet seed aliceCoins.

def bhE2EFinishStartSpk {S : SignalPqxdh.Setup} {ℓ : ℕ} (C : Crypto) (K : LibsignalSpqrV1.MlKem) (bMode? : Option Bool) (σ : BHE2EDrvState S ℓ) (sid : SignalPqxdh.SessionId S) (kr1 kr2 : SignalPqxdh.KeyIndResponse) (aliceCoins : BitVec 256) : Option ℕ × BHE2EDrvState S ℓ := match bhE2EGuard σ sid, kr1, kr2 with | some (hdr, bnd, (u, j)), .drKeyResp dk, .spkSkResp spkSk => if dk.rootKey.length == 32 && dk.chainKey.length == 32 && dk.pqrKey.length == 32 && spkSk.length == 32 then let idA := bhIdKeyOf hdr.ikAPk; let idB := bhIdKeyOf bnd.ikB let spkCoins := bhBytesWord spkSk let kS : SampledSessionKey := bhKeySOf dk aliceCoins let spqr := LibsignalSpqrV1.spqrV1SessionUniformCoins C.F K let sch := sessionSchemeFixedSpk (paramsIdsWithSpqr C spqr idA idB) ℓ spkCoins let gs := bMode?.map (fun b => SM.initState sch.sendPart kS b) let inst : BHModelInst S ℓ := { sid, hdr, idA, idB, spkCoins, gs } let im : ModelDriverInstanceMeta S := { respPrin := some u, respSpkIdx := some j, instOpkId? := hdr.opkId? } (some σ.insts.length, { σ with insts := σ.insts ++ [inst], instMeta := σ.instMeta ++ [im] }) else (none, σ) | _, _, _ => (none, σ)

def bhE2ECostBudgetL1019–1033 ↗#

Step-cost budget for the model-state composition reductions, bounding per-query dispatch and clamped table scans (min b.q_total S.N_*, min qStart nSend) together with the post-game allTestedSessionsFresh pass.

def bhE2ECostBudget (S : SignalPqxdh.Setup) (b : SignalPqxdh.QueryBudget) (qStart qDR qInst qep ℓ : ℕ) : ℕ := let nId := min b.q_total S.N_id let nSpk := min b.q_total S.N_spk_tot let nOpk := min b.q_total S.N_opk_tot let nSend := min b.q_total S.N_send_tot let nRecv := min b.q_total S.N_recv_tot let nInst := min qStart nSend 2 ^ 10 * (b.q_total + qStart + qDR + 1) * (b.q_total + nOpk + nInst + qInst + Nat.log 2 qep + 10 * (nId + nSpk + nSend + nRecv) + maxForwardJumps + ℓ + 1) + 2 ^ 13 * nInst * (nId + nSpk + nRecv + 1)

def bhE2ECostBudgetByKindL1035–1058 ↗#

Per-kind step-cost budget for the model-state composition reductions under bhQueryKind: clamps session and key table scans at the online count M_on = min b.q_on b.q_total (Q_on = M_on + qStart + qDR), adds logarithmic random-oracle table lookup/insert cost across at most M_ro + 2 * Q_on + 1 entries (M_ro = min b.q_ro b.q_total), and retains the post-game allTestedSessionsFresh pass. The table term can pay for a balanced lookup-tree walk of O(bits K) steps per offline query, K = M_ro + 2 * Q_on + 1; the current E2E proofs forward each .roQuery to the target game in O(bits M_on) steps, which roStep_mul_le_roTableTerm (Proofs/E2E/Dsl/PrefixRedHaltedByKind.lean) bounds by the table term.

def bhE2ECostBudgetByKind (S : SignalPqxdh.Setup) (b : SignalPqxdh.QueryBudget) (qStart qDR qInst qep ℓ : ℕ) : ℕ := let M_on := min b.q_on b.q_total let M_ro := min b.q_ro b.q_total let Q_on := M_on + qStart + qDR let nId := min M_on S.N_id let nSpk := min M_on S.N_spk_tot let nOpk := min M_on S.N_opk_tot let nSend := min M_on S.N_send_tot let nRecv := min M_on S.N_recv_tot let nInst := min qStart nSend 2 ^ 10 * (Q_on + 1) * (M_on + nOpk + nInst + qInst + Nat.log 2 qep + 10 * (nId + nSpk + nSend + nRecv) + maxForwardJumps + ℓ + 1) + 2 ^ 13 * (M_ro + Q_on) * (ReductionDsl.bits (M_ro + 2 * Q_on + 1) + 4) + 2 ^ 13 * nInst * (nId + nSpk + nRecv + 1)

def GRed2BoundedL1060–1087 ↗#

Step-cost, program-size, query-count, size-honesty, and run-local block-width bound on a ReductionDsl.TwoStageCostedReduction: whenever every adversary game query and every target oracle answer on a run fits width B, the stage-1 checkpoint and stage-2 output fit 2 * (costBudget + q + 1) * (B + 1).

def GRed2Bounded {S : ReductionDsl.Sig} {O : ReductionDsl.Ops S} {ι κ : Type} {T : OracleSpec ι} {I : ReductionDsl.Iface S T} {G : OracleSpec κ} {C : ReductionDsl.GameCodec S G} {rIn aIn aOut ch rIn2 out : ReductionDsl.Ty S} (R : ReductionDsl.TwoStageCostedReduction O I G C rIn aIn aOut ch rIn2 out) (wTag : I.Tag → ℕ) (wSamp : I.smp.Samp → ℕ) (q qOut costBudget : ℕ) (dflt : aOut.denote) : Prop := R.totalCost q ≤ costBudget ∧ R.size ≤ ReductionDsl.reductionSizeBudget + 2 ^ 12 * ReductionDsl.bits costBudget ∧ R.init.queries wTag wSamp + R.handlePre.queries wTag wSamp + R.chDone.queries wTag wSamp = 0 ∧ R.totalQueries wTag wSamp q ≤ qOut ∧ CostedOpsSizeHonest O ∧ CostedSampSizeHonest I.smp ∧ ∀ (B : ℕ), (∀ v : aOut.denote, CostedFits B aOut v) → ∀ (A : aIn.denote → OracleComp (unifSpec + G) aOut.denote), (∀ a, ReductionDsl.AllGameQueriesFit B C (A a)) → ∀ (x : rIn.denote), CostedFits B rIn x → let widthB := 2 * (costBudget + q + 1) * (B + 1) ∀ cm ∈ ReductionDsl.supportWhen (I.AnswerFits B) (R.eval1 A x q dflt), CostedFits widthB ch cm.1 ∧ ∀ (y : rIn2.denote), CostedFits B rIn2 y → ∀ z ∈ ReductionDsl.supportWhen (I.AnswerFits B) (R.eval2 cm.2 y q dflt), CostedFits widthB out z

def stageOneAsProbCompL1089–1101 ↗#

Evaluate a coin-only stage-1 computation in ProbComp by answering unused SM queries with bhModelSmDefault.

def stageOneAsProbComp {ℓ : ℕ} {PQC α : Type} (oa : OracleComp (unifSpec + SM.spec (GhostState Bytes) (Plain ℓ) PQC Bytes) α) : ProbComp α := simulateQ (QueryImpl.ofLift unifSpec ProbComp + (fun q => pure (bhModelSmDefault q) : QueryImpl (SM.spec (GhostState Bytes) (Plain ℓ) PQC Bytes) ProbComp)) oa
